description: A demo script for generating and printing QR codes using the qrcodegen library, including various examples and utility functions.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Class representing a QR code with methods for encoding data, retrieving modules, and generating SVG strings.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Class representing segments of data for QR code encoding, with factory methods for different segment types.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the demo suite.

methods.name: do_basic_demo
methods.description: Creates and prints a basic QR code with 'Hello, world!' text.

methods.name: do_variety_demo
methods.description: Creates and prints various QR codes with different data types and features.

methods.name: do_segment_demo
methods.description: Creates QR codes with manually specified segments for better data compression.

methods.name: do_mask_demo
methods.description: Creates QR codes with different mask patterns to compare visual differences.

methods.name: print_qr
methods.description: Utility function to print a QR code to the console.
